title: Harness Guardrails: Enforced Boundaries
objective: After this lesson you will be able to layer input validation, output filters, approval hooks, and audit logging inside the harness — with attack gold proving each layer independently.
why: Prompts request good behavior; harnesses enforce it. A scope sentence ignored is a suggestion; a validation layer is a wall. Money paths, PII flows, and external actions need enforcement that survives model creativity, prompt drift, and version changes — layered, logged, and tested with bypass attempts, not vibes.

blocks.text: Request vs enforce: both layers, different jobs

Prompts **request** (scope sentences, abstention paths, contracts); harness **enforces** (schema validation, approval gates, output filters, rate limits, audit). Request-only protection fails open on first bypass; enforcement-only fights the model on every edge. Both layers, tested separately: prompt compliance in eval, enforcement in attack gold with bypass attempts.

blocks.caption: In/out/money/audit: four enforcement points, one audit trail

blocks.text: Approval hooks on money and externals

Side-effecting actions pass **approval hooks**: amount-gated refunds, external sends, deletions — human or policy verdict required, edits re-validated, skips logged. Hooks live in the harness (not the prompt) so version changes and model swaps never silently drop them. Untested hooks rot: attack gold exercises approval paths quarterly.

Append-only audit per action (who/what/args/verdict/outcome/timestamp) enables pattern review: denied-attempt spikes (campaigns), approval latency (bottlenecks), bypass shapes (new attacks → new gold). Audit without review is write-only comfort; scheduled pattern reviews (weekly for money paths) close the loop.

blocks.title: Enforce the layers
blocks.note: Run it: expect true, injection-pattern, true, forbidden-promise, true, false — in order. Input/output/approval layers each decide independently; enforcement never depends on prompt compliance.

items: Prompts request, harness enforces: validation in, filters out, hooks on money/externals, audit always
Attack gold tests enforcement (bypass attempts), eval tests compliance — separate suites, both required
Audit reviewed by pattern on schedule; denied spikes signal campaigns

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice enforcer and map all six verdicts. (b) Add a PII-output check (emails/cards in generated text → quarantine) with a test. (c) Write the approval-hook test for a $500 refund (gate triggers, verdict paths) mirroring the LangGraph HITL pattern.
hints: Mappings: true / injection-pattern / true / forbidden-promise / true / false (in order) — layers independent.
PII check: email/card patterns on outputs → quarantine with evidence (Production Ch.6 discipline, harness-enforced).
Hook test: amount>100 → gate; approve/edit/skip paths each exercised with validated edits.
exercise.why: Layer mapping (which check fires per input), extension (new PII layer), and hook testing (verdict paths) are the three enforcement judgments — each verified, with attack gold pinning each layer.
exercise.code: // Enforcement-extension pattern: new layer + test + attack gold pin.

quiz.q: Scope sentence ignored by new model version. Protection?
options: Harness enforcement (validation layers, approval hooks) holds regardless of prompt compliance — request and enforce are separate layers
quiz.explain: Prompts degrade across versions; enforcement doesn't. Layered defense survives what single-layer requesting cannot.

options: Campaign signal: review patterns, tighten targeted rules, preserve logs — denied attempts are threat intelligence
quiz.explain: Denials are data: spikes indicate probing campaigns. Pattern review converts attempts into rule improvements.

quiz.q: Approval hooks untested for a year. Status?
options: Rotted: untested gates decay (model/prompt drift bypasses them silently) — attack gold exercises hooks quarterly
quiz.explain: Gates rot as surrounding behavior shifts. Quarterly attack-gold exercise proves enforcement continuously, not once.

summary: Request in prompts, enforce in harness: validation in, filters out, hooks on money/externals, audit always, attack gold per layer. Boundaries held structurally.
next: Bounded and enforced — now measured: gold sets, attribution, and no-regression gates for harness changes. Next: evaluating harnesses.
